value.finding: context-pack, state-diff, and proof-card exist as separate edge utilities. None of them assemble a portable continuation envelope from caller-supplied pieces. A CLI that composes those functions into one bounded pack (context required; delta and last_proof only when supplied) is a real public edge utility: WORTH_IT. No model, no network, no authority.

duplication.finding: UNIQUE. No package in this repo assembles a continuation envelope. context-pack compiles one state. state-diff compares two objects. proof-card projects one record. cheap-route scores routes. The starter core writes receipts and manifests. handoff-pack calls the existing functions; it does not reimplement them.

public_boundary.finding: CLEAR. Caller-supplied JSON only. Fail-closed on private/conversational keys (same refusal set as context-pack / state-diff). No AXON/Mother/Governance/recipes/weights/scoring/prompts/customer data/production authority/private URLs. No private-repo imports. from/to are operator-declared public labels. CLI only; not a fourth MCP tool or fourth skill.

limitations: Packs only caller-supplied public pieces. Grants no mutation or production authority.
Not a lifecycle attestation, private state store, or orchestration handoff.
from_run and to_run are operator-declared public labels, not runtime authority.
